name: plain-language
purpose: Reading grade, phrase rules and carelessness checks for any text
usedFor: Any text a person will read from an automated system: reading grade against their chosen level, phrase rules for tone, and catching careless output. `sentence()` closes a sentence once, so "5 p.m." never becomes "5 p.m..".
notFor: Languages other than English for the grade (the formula is English-only; the app records Spanish grade as not measured), judging meaning or accuracy, or translation.
